_comment: Single source of truth for the events collection validator. Loaded by server/db.js (Node) and scripts/reset_db.py (Python). additionalProperties:false means a document can ONLY contain the fields listed here — a stray field like 'name' is rejected by MongoDB. This is how 'collect no personal data' is enforced in the database itself.

type.description: What kind of event this is.

questionId.description: Question id, e.g. dd1. Null for mystery topics.

answerId.description: Answer id (a/b/c/d) or mystery topic key. Null for tile picks.

correct.description: Whether the chosen answer was correct. Null unless type=answer.

station.description: Which table/station produced the event. No personal data.
